findings.title: Controlled validation of exposed laboratory service
findings.description: A controlled Metasploit validation module confirmed that the intentionally exposed SecureCommerce laboratory service is reachable and responds to the expected application probe.
findings.impact: An exposed service increases the attack surface and should be restricted to approved network boundaries.
findings.remediation: Restrict service exposure to the intended laboratory network and ensure that application-level security controls are independently enforced.
